verdict.rationale: Bento documents subscriber import through a bulk API (create/update without triggering automations) and CSV import in its CLI. Its docs say tags and custom fields can be set via imports, and the pricing page offers migration help when switching, with community users reporting moves from Mailchimp and HubSpot. Missing for 10: a documented guided, platform-specific import flow (the migration help reads as a human service), any evidence that unsubscribe state is preserved on import, and hands-on corroboration that tags and fields map cleanly from another platform.
